title: An insular–orbitofrontal pathway supporting awareness of respiratory effort
title_zh: 支持呼吸努力意识的岛叶-眶额皮质通路
abstract: In a recent study using human intracranial EEG recordings during inspiratory loading, Assi and colleagues identified parallel pathways for respiratory compensation and awareness. The anterior insula signals a neuromechanical mismatch to the orbitofrontal cortex for conscious appraisal, while high-frequency insular-frontal coupling enables ventilatory adjustments. The findings are highly relevant for disorders of altered respiratory perception.
abstract_zh: 在一项最近的研究中，Assi 等人利用人类颅内 EEG 在吸气负荷条件下进行记录，发现了呼吸补偿与意识的平行通路。前岛叶向眶额皮质发出神经机械失配信号，以供意识评估，而高频岛叶-额叶耦合则实现通气调节。该发现对呼吸感知异常疾病具有重要意义。
